description:
The TPC-DS dsdgen tool has broken stdout support due to two bugs that were
introduced when official TPC imports (v2.10.0, v4.0.0) reverted community fixes.

Bug 1 - Parameter name mismatch (params.h):
  - Help shows `_FILTER` but code calls `is_set("FILTER")` without underscore
  - fnd_param() uses prefix matching so "FILTER" never matches "_FILTER"

Bug 2 - fpOutfile overwrite (print.c):
  - Line 449 sets `fpOutfile = stdout` when FILTER is set
  - Line 485 unconditionally overwrites with `fpOutfile = pTdef->outfile` (NULL)
  - Result: "Failed to open output file!" error

These bugs affect both _sources/tpc-ds and the prebuilt binaries in _binaries/tpc-ds/.

Original fix by Greg Rahn (gregrahn) in commit 7992dbb of tpcds-kit repo.
